summary: Atour: Chinese mid-to-upscale hotel franchisor with a fast-growing retail (sleep products) arm. Asset-light, high cash returns, pays dividends; China consumer and country risk apply.

rationale.growthHigh: Hotel openings (~20% a year) plus retail growing faster; ~15% blended as the base grows.
rationale.targetMargin: Current operating margin ~22%; franchise model keeps it there.
rationale.salesToCapital: Franchisees fund most hotels, so little capital is needed.
rationale.exitMultiple: 15x: China consumer names trade at a discount to US peers for country risk.

thesis.text: Atour runs a franchise-led upscale hotel chain in China and sells its hotel sleep products (pillows, bedding) through retail. Asset-light, high returns, net cash and a growing dividend.
bull: Retail arm growing fast with high margins
bear: China consumer slowdown and hotel price (RevPAR) pressure
US-China delisting or tariff risk for the ADR

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
